profile.name: Sachin Suresh
profile.title: AI / ML Engineer
profile.headline: I build agentic AI systems that ship to production.
profile.summary: Lead AI Engineer Intern at Capmob Financial Services and Computer Science undergrad at Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering. I design LLM agents, RAG pipelines and ML-driven decision systems end to end, from the model loop to the AWS infrastructure and CI gates that keep them running.

education.degree: Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science

experience.description: Leading the AI engineering of Capmob AI, an SME lending platform built on FastAPI and AWS Bedrock.
highlights: Architected Capmob AI, an SME lending platform on FastAPI + AWS Bedrock: an adaptive interview engine, a deterministic 50-parameter CapScore credit-scoring model with lender-policy fit, and event-driven document ingestion (S3, SQS, Postgres) with concurrent classification and sub-minute extraction.

Automated partner onboarding with Zoho: referral CRM lead sync, Zoho Sign agreements with template prefill, and webhook handling with missed-webhook reconciliation and capped retries; added KYC autofill from PDF uploads in a single classify-and-extract call.

Managed AWS infrastructure (ECS/Fargate, RDS, ALB, Route 53/ACM, Secrets Manager, KMS, DynamoDB) with CI security gates (Semgrep, Gitleaks, pip-audit, coverage thresholds); built the company website on a custom headless CMS, saving $300+/month in licensing.

experience.description: Built production dashboards and agentic automation workflows for manufacturing operations.
highlights: Built production dashboards (React + Flask) visualizing operational trends across manufacturing pipelines with sub-second response times.
Designed agentic n8n automation workflows integrating custom AI agents, structured JSON parsers and multi-condition decision logic for end-to-end process orchestration.

projects.name: Harness
projects.tagline: Custom AI agent runtime, built from scratch
projects.description: A tool-calling agent runtime written from scratch (no LangGraph or AutoGPT) on Groq's gpt-oss-20b, with a dedicated safeguard model and two-tier persistent memory.
highlights: Tool-calling agent loop wiring 6 tools (web search, weather, calculator, sandboxed code exec, file I/O, email) into a 10-iteration reasoning loop.
Guarded by a dedicated gpt-oss-safeguard-20b model that screens user input, every tool call and the final output.
Two-tier memory: an LLM-distilled episodic log feeding a 384-dim FAISS semantic index for persistent cross-session recall.

projects.name: UnBind
projects.description: A full-stack contract analyzer that ingests PDF, DOCX and photographed contracts, flags risky clauses, answers questions with verified citations and reminds you before deadlines are missed.
highlights: Ingests PDF, DOCX and photographed contracts via Groq vision OCR, fanning out clause-by-clause risk analysis in parallel with SSE progress streaming across an 8-stage pipeline.

Citation-verified Q&A engine using HyDE retrieval with character-offset source citations, plus a deadline-reminder system with deterministic date parsing across 8 resolution classes and an idempotent GitHub Actions sweep.

Payments hardened with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification and atomic quota enforcement, backed by a 299-test suite (281 pytest + 18 vitest) gated in CI by ruff, eslint, tsc and Gitleaks; also shipped as an npm CLI REPL.
